- Central lesion: pinkish/salmon, angular (vein-bounded), with a whitish center area

- Septoria: Small circular tan spots - more circular, not angular
- Gray_Mold: Margin-starting tan lesions - doesn't match

The angular vein-bounded shape is characteristic of bacterial infection. The central lesion has a pinkish-tan surround with a whitish center — matching the "bird's-eye" pattern (dark lesion + white halo) described for Bacterial_Canker. The satellite spots to the left also fit multiple infection sites.
